info.title: Havano POS - SaaS Backoffice API
info.description: API specification for Havano POS SaaS & Backoffice mode. Default server: https://backoffice.havano.pro.

tags.name: Auth & Multi-Tenant Terminals
tags.description: Authentication, terminal takeover/binding, user sessions, active shops and roles

tags.name: Products, Catalog & Bundles
tags.description: Product sync, price lists, barcodes, combo bundles, item groups, and UOMs

tags.name: Customers & Loyalty
tags.description: Customer accounts, sync, search, creation, balance checks, loyalty points and permissions

tags.name: Sales Invoices & POS Upload
tags.description: Sales invoice creation, return credit notes, POS submission, and invoice verification

tags.name: Sales Orders & Quotations
tags.description: Sales orders pulling/upload, quotations sync, creation, and cancellation

tags.name: Payments, MOPs & Shifts
tags.description: Payment entries, Modes of Payment, multi-currency rates, cash transfers, cashbook, and shift management

tags.name: Expenses Management
tags.description: Petty cash claims, expense categories, approvals, and expense synchronization

tags.name: Medical & Pharmacy
tags.description: Doctors and prescription dosage directions push and sync

tags.name: Inventory & Stock
tags.description: Real-time stock queries, stock entries, warehouse locations, and stock reconciliations

tags.name: Suppliers & Purchasing
tags.description: Supplier registration, purchase invoices, and procurement sync

tags.name: Master Data & Setup
tags.description: Currencies, exchange rates, chart of accounts, tax categories, countries, and company registration

tags.name: ZIMRA Fiscalization
tags.description: Havano ZIMRA cloud gateway: tokens, day open/close (Z-Report), status, and fiscal invoice transmission

tags.name: Restaurant & Hospitality
tags.description: Dining areas, table statuses, Kitchen Order Tickets (KOT), and table order closures

tags.name: Subscriptions & Billing
tags.description: SaaS subscription plans, status, balance top-ups, and subscription renewal payments

tags.name: Reports & Analytics
tags.description: Daily sales, gross margin analysis, cashier performance, and Frappe Query Reports

tags.name: Support & Helpdesk
tags.description: Support ticket creation and issue reporting directly from POS
